title: Post-discovery follow-up — proactive reslots & tight confirmation (StellarOps)
text:
Post-discovery follow-up — proactive reslots & tight confirmation (StellarOps)

['From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Park <samantha.park@stellarops.com>, Chris Li <chris.li@stellarops.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Missed discovery / quick next steps and tight reslot options

Hi Samantha / Chris —

Sorry we missed each other on the discovery this morning; I know schedules get tight. I pulled together a very short recap of what we planned to cover (attached) so nobody loses the thread. High-level:

- Goal: validate inference cost/latency targets for your beta workload + integration constraints.
- Key ask from you: provide a short sample traffic profile and any hard region/IP constraints.
- Next step: 30–45m technical deep-dive with eng to scope a pilot and confirm performance numbers.

I have a couple of tight windows in the next 48 hours we can lock if either of these work — I want to be respectful of your calendar so I can hold one if you reply with a firm yes:

Option A — Thu Jul 15, 10:00–10:30 AM PT (30m)
Option B — Thu Jul 15, 3:00–3:45 PM PT (45m)
Option C — Fri Jul 16, 9:00–9:30 AM PT (30m)

Marissa (cc) would join as our Solutions Engineer for the deep-dive. If none of the slots work, tell me two times that do and I’ll circle back. If I don’t hear back by EOD tomorrow I’ll free the slots and follow up next week.

Attachments: post-discovery-notes.pdf (one-page recap), proposed-agenda.xlsx (draft agenda)

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

', "From: Samantha Park <samantha.park@stellarops.com>

Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Missed discovery / quick next steps and tight reslot options

Hi Rishi —

Apologies — we had an internal escalation this morning and I couldn't make the call. Thanks for the notes; the recap is helpful.

Quick update on our side: Friday morning is tricky because we have a release, but I can do Friday 1:30–2:00 PM PT if that helps. Otherwise I can do Monday Jul 19 mid-morning. We do want our lead infra engineer on the deep-dive — Chris is cc'd and should be available for the Friday 1:30 slot.

Can you confirm whether Marissa will cover deployment sizing and what artifacts you need from us ahead of the call? If you can send a 1–2 line list of must-have pre-read items, I’ll pull them together.

Thanks —
Samantha Park
Director, Product @ StellarOps
samantha.park@stellarops.com

Subject: Re: Missed discovery / quick next steps and tight reslot options

Thanks Samantha — understood on the release. Chris, thanks for being flexible if you can join.

Given the tight timeline and your release calendar, can you confirm one of the two short slots below? If you reply with the exact slot text I’ll lock it immediately on our side and send an invite with an explicit agenda and attendee list. We’re trying to keep the meeting focused so engineers can be efficient.

Firm options (please reply with the exact option to confirm):

Option 1 — Fri Jul 16, 1:30–2:00 PM PT (30m) — Eng + AE + Solutions Eng (Marissa)
Option 2 — Mon Jul 19, 10:30–11:15 AM PT (45m) — Eng + AE + Solutions Eng (Marissa)

Pre-reads / minimal artifacts requested:
- A short sample traffic profile (CSV) or a bullet list with average tokens/sec and peak tokens/sec
- Any IP/region exclusions for your pilot

Attachment note: I re-attached the one-pager recap and a condensed agenda.

If neither option works, tell me the single best 30-min window on Monday and we’ll do our best to accommodate. Otherwise a one-word reply ("Option 1" or "Option 2") is perfect and I’ll lock the invite.

Appreciate it —
Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0192
